integrity: The lower bound is an exhaustive recursion justified by the longest-border lemma for squarefree words. The verifier reproduces all five previously published minima before establishing 142. Independent audit has not been performed.
scientific_limitations: The result determines only the next exact minimum g(5); it does not give a formula or asymptotic for larger numbers of periods.
title: The sixth ternary squarefree-period minimum is \(142\)
